Both clusters center on the idea that true liberation or wisdom arises from an internal shift in perception—away from external judgments, imposed suffering, or moral valuations—and toward self-acceptance and the recovery of inherent truth. Cluster 1 critiques the projection of moral value onto external states and frames enlightenment as an internal recovery, while Cluster 11 elaborates on releasing self-punishment and reframing hardship as a product of perception. Together, they bridge on the concept of **inner reorientation** as the path to freedom.

**Conclusion:** Inner reorientation (self-acceptance and perceptual reframing)
